title: HTTPX Async Connection Pool & Timeout Optimization
Network Latency Profiler & Adaptive Timeout Engine for East African Infrastructure
rationale: Current HTTPX pool optimizations are generic. In Kitengela and Nairobi, network conditions fluctuate wildly due to ISP congestion and cellular handoffs. A static timeout often causes false negatives during brief spikes. This module proactively profiles local network latency to dynamic adjust timeouts, ensuring Cortana remains responsive and doesn't hang during transient network blips common in the region.
next_hypothesis: Implement a 'Contextual Power Saver' that dynamically adjusts CPU frequency and background task frequency based on battery level and thermal state to extend operational uptime during power outages in Kitengela.
